summary: Tested BOTH new features (Foto Nota Pintar OCR + Ingatkan Otomatis inactivity reminder) end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 new pytest tests PASS - OCR extract returns {amount:144855.0, date:'2026-01-15', found:true} for /tmp/nota_test.png; PDF upload correctly returns 400 with Indonesian message ('Baca otomatis hanya mendukung foto JPG/PNG'); cross-tenant extract by msme2 on msme1's receipt returns 403; toko.maju reminder=false; kedai.nusantara reminder=true with inactive_days=5 and creates exactly 1 inactivity_reminder notification (idempotent - 2nd call does not duplicate). Frontend: 4/4 UI flows PASS - kedai.nusantara dashboard shows blue inactivity-reminder-banner with text 'Sudah 5 hari Anda belum mencatat transaksi...' + Catat Sekarang button opens transaction dialog; toko.maju dashboard has NO reminder banner; OCR auto-fill flow works - selecting nota_test.png via receipt-file-input auto-fills amount-input='144.855' and date-input='2026-01-15' within ~3s, ocr-hint visible, submit succeeds; admin login smoke passes. Regression smoke also passed (health, admin/msme login, transaction filters).

issues: Non-blocking React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription for a11y.

critical_code_review_comments: OCR endpoint correctly runs Tesseract in threadpool (non-blocking) and returns 422 on OCR exceptions - good.
extract endpoint properly enforces tenant isolation via assert_business_access before touching object storage.

reminder idempotency uses today.isoformat() string prefix ('2026-01-15') as $gte against created_at ISO strings - works due to lexicographic ordering; consider migrating to datetime objects for robustness.
server.py is now 833 lines - past the 700-line guideline; splitting receipts/reminders/notifications into routers is overdue.
Prior iteration_1 finding still open: GET /api/transactions?business_id=<other> returns 200 instead of 403 (not re-tested this iteration, out-of-scope).
seed_data_creation: Test uploaded 3 receipt images (nota_test.png x2, fake.pdf) via /api/receipts for msme1 - harmless residual data. Also created 1 TEST_recent income transaction (Rp1.000) for toko.maju to guarantee active-state before reminder assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (OCR extract + inactivity reminder) are fully working. New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py. Note: msme2 (kedai.nusantara) transactions were intentionally backdated 5 days to satisfy the reminder scenario - DO NOT reseed or fix. OCR takes 2-4s typically.
